item.description: Choose a country, or all countries to see the available international channel lists.
Choose the broadcaster or platform whose free-to-air channels you want to add.
Choose a region offered by this channel list, or keep the provider's default selection.
Create TV and radio bouquets in the provider's channel order. Disable this to update global fallback mappings for your existing bouquets only. Existing bouquets are kept.
Show additional filters and playback settings. These are not needed for normal channel-list creation.
Enable DVB-I channel-list updates and registered internet alternatives.
Optionally narrow the available lists to one provider.
All languages accepts every language; choosing a language filters the available lists.
Optionally filter lists by their announced reception methods.

Yes prefers matching free-to-air satellite, cable or terrestrial channels. No creates an IP-only list and skips channels without a usable free-to-air stream. Regions and reception modes have separate bouquets.
Use a registered internet alternative when no tuner is free or reception fails. This applies in every bouquet. Recordings and timeshift are not moved.
Prefer automatic DVB-I mappings over manual assignments. Disable this to give manual mappings priority. Both mappings are kept when updates run. Press EPG to edit manual mappings.

Automatic prefers GStreamer 4097 and falls back to a suitable installed player. A fixed selection only imports streams supported by that player. Native DVB playback requires verified HTTP transport streams.
Download channel logos in the background and install them in the normal Enigma2 picon paths. Existing picons are kept.
Load programme information into the normal Enigma2 programme guide. Programme guide updates can also be scheduled independently of channel updates.
How many days to request, where supplied by the provider. Existing programme information is retained when a provider is unavailable.
Storage for downloaded channel data and diagnostics.
